name: NexLevel

issues.info: Report bugs on the NexLevel page (include your Geode log)

description: Create Together. Build Beyond. Real-time collaborative level editing with your friends.

relay-server.name: Private relay (optional)
relay-server.description: Your own relay server (host or host:port). Leave empty to use the official relays. Everyone joining a private-relay room needs the same address here.

show-ping.name: Show ping in the editor
show-ping.description: Shows your ping to the room in the editor while you are in a room.

show-frames.name: Show other players' view
show-frames.description: Draws a coloured frame with each player's name where they are working in the editor.

relay-directory.name: Relay directory URL
relay-directory.description: Where NexLevel downloads the list of official relays. Leave as is unless you run your own network.

show-trails.name: Show playtests
show-trails.description: When someone playtests, watch their icon play in your editor and see the trail they leave, in their colour.
